title: LoBoost: Model-Native Local Conformal Prediction for Gradient-Boosted Trees
abstract: arXiv:2602.22432v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Gradient-boosted decision trees are among the strongest off-the-shelf predictors for tabular regression, but point predictions alone do not quantify uncertainty. Conformal prediction provides distribution-free marginal coverage, yet standard split conformal uses a single global residual quantile and can adapt poorly to heteroscedasticity. We propose LoBoost, a model-native local conformal method that reuses the fitted ensemble's leaf structure to define a multiscale partition of the feature space. Each input is represented by the sequence of leaves it visits along the boosting path, and matching leaf prefixes define nested groups in which residual quantiles are estimated locally. By reusing the predictive structure already learned by the model, LoBoost requires no auxiliary partition or nuisance model, no retraining, and no additional data split beyond standard conformal calibration. Our theory connects the stability of the fit

translated_title: LoBoost：面向梯度提升树的模型原生局部保形预测
translated_abstract: 梯度提升决策树是表格回归中最强大的现成预测器之一，但仅靠点预测无法量化不确定性。保形预测可以提供无分布的边际覆盖保证，然而标准的分割保形方法只使用单一的全局残差分位数，难以适应异方差性。我们提出LoBoost，一种模型原生的局部保形方法，它重用已拟合集成模型的叶结构来定义特征空间的多尺度划分。每个输入由其沿提升路径所经过的叶节点序列来表示，匹配的叶前缀定义了嵌套分组，并在这些分组内局部估计残差分位数。通过重用模型已经学习到的预测结构，LoBoost无需辅助划分或干扰模型，无需重新训练，也无需在标准保形校准之外进行额外的数据分割。我们的理论将拟合的稳定性……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: LoBoost通过重用梯度提升树集成模型自身的叶结构构建多尺度嵌套分组，实现模型原生的局部保形预测，无需辅助划分、重训练或额外数据分割即可局部估计残差分位数并适应异方差性。
en_tdlr: LoBoost is a model-native local conformal prediction method that reuses the leaf structure of fitted gradient-boosted ensembles to define multiscale nested groups for local residual quantile estimation, adapting to heteroscedasticity without auxiliary partitions, retraining, or extra data splits.
